title: Share blocking HTTP body framing without changing client behavior
goal: Reduce Susi core runtime source through one shared std-only body decoder while preserving public APIs, diagnostics, framing rules, limits and timeout propagation.

reuse.searched: Compared the existing config/plain_http, wire-client/http and http-transport/wire body decoders. Reuse the near-identical first two, keeping the third's distinct framing behavior. No external source or package is needed. susi-paths already shares the same serde-json dependency as wire-client, so a wire-client -> paths edge adds no external reach and does not enlarge the pillar closure.

limitations: Local scoped work only; no external board message, commit or publication. Parent read the Susi Board at item 1604 before delegation.
Root architecture/thin-client tests and integrated workspace checks remain for parent integration. No release qualified; Linux host tests only; no claim of full protocol conformance.

cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-paths -p susi-config -p susi-wire-client --all-targets -- -D warnings

Pillar closure unchanged. Shared paths only depends on the existing serde-json facade.
